title: Saudi Arabian Cheese Fritters
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish made with crispy cheese fritters, perfect for a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: Vibrant Cheese
ingredients.notes: Low-fat cheese for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Arabian Cookies
ingredients.notes: Pistachio cookies work well in this recipe

ingredients.name: Sodium
ingredients.notes: Only use if needed for extra flavor

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian Flour
ingredients.notes: Use a fine all-purpose flour for the best results

ingredients.name: Vibrant Egg
ingredients.notes: Use room temperature egg for better mixing

ingredients.name: Low Fat Milk
ingredients.notes: Whole milk can be used if preferred

ingredients.name: Vibrant Baking Powder
ingredients.notes: Use fresh baking powder for the best results

ingredients.name: Sodium Salt
ingredients.notes: Only use if needed for extra flavor

instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, and sodium salt (if using).
In a separate bowl, whisk together the low-fat milk, vibrant egg, and crushed cookies. Add the shredded cheese and mix until combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Using a spoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the cheese fritters warm and enjoy!
